modern-reconciliation.title: Begin an honest conversation
modern-reconciliation.alt: Two men sit facing one another across a picnic table, one speaking and the other listening.
modern-reconciliation.caption: A phone is set aside as two people give a difficult conversation their attention. This present-day illustration invites us to speak honestly and listen with care.

modern-welcome.title: Make a place at the table
modern-welcome.alt: A woman pulls out a chair for a guest carrying a plate at a community meal.
modern-welcome.caption: A chair is drawn out and a guest is welcomed. This present-day illustration invites us to notice who might appreciate a place beside us.

modern-prayer.title: Turn to God before the day begins
modern-prayer.alt: A man in work clothes bows his head and clasps his hands at a kitchen table before dawn.
modern-prayer.caption: Work gloves and a lunch bag wait while a man pauses to pray. This present-day illustration invites us to bring ordinary responsibilities and concerns to God.
